title: Gary Nolan's strontium UFO metamaterial sample

tellings.quote: isn't strontium I believe is one of Gary Nolan's pieces that he has at the you know Stanford lab that he thinks might be UFO metamaterials that come from crashes I believe has strontium in it

plain: One of the samples the scientist Garry Nolan keeps at his Stanford lab, which Nolan thinks might be UFO 'metamaterials', engineered materials from crashed craft, is said to contain strontium, a metal element. Michels says this himself, from memory and with an 'I believe', without naming a source. He brings it up because strontium came up in another context, and a match would link it to possible crash debris.
